name: Mace of Terror
summary: A mace that releases a wave of terror, frightening nearby creatures, using charges.

stats.effect: This magic weapon has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding the weapon, you can take a {ref:glossary/magic} action and expend 1 charge to release a wave of terror from it. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the {ref:condition/frightened} condition for 1 minute. While {ref:condition/frightened} in this way, a creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't make {ref:glossary/opportunity-attacks}. For its action, it can use only the {ref:glossary/dash} action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If it has nowhere it can move, the creature can take the {ref:glossary/dodge} action. At the end of each of its turns, a creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
